reason: Panel packing is the strongest distinct n=512 layout proposal: it keeps a 32-row A panel in 64 KiB and retains one SME entry, though repacking may erase any benefit. Prefetching and transpose fusion also target n=512 data movement, but neither has evidence of a bottleneck; fusion has high implementation risk. Indexed addressing and joint end-pointer checks are unmeasured, with likely loop-control gains limited and address-generation risk. The two-K loop change is close to the previously measured unroll, while ZA remapping and explicit tail vectors have no supplied performance rationale. A transpose fusion for the general-size path cannot improve the timed n=512 case.
